description: This file manages the movement (reordering) of mail scanner rules within the vtiger CRM MailScanner module. It processes requests to move rules up or down in a sequence by invoking methods from the Vtiger_MailScannerRule class.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerRule
classes.description: A class responsible for handling mail scanner rules, particularly their sequencing.

methods.name: resetSequence
methods.description: Changes the position of a mail scanner rule within its sequence, moving it up or down based on provided rule IDs.
